# Regression Safety Checklist: Production Triage Outcome Routing

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009F requirements preserve existing remediation, routing, workflow, and verification boundaries while adding recommendation-only triage routing.
**Created**: 2026-05-21
**Feature**: `specs/009f-production-triage-routing/spec.md`

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Remediation Flow Preservation

- [ ] CHK001 Are `ACTIONABLE_REMEDIATION` ownership and existing remediation successor behavior explicitly preserved outside SPEC-009F routing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Contract §Routing Helper Contract]
- [ ] CHK002 Are supported non-remediation outcomes clearly distinguished from remediation outcomes so routing cannot be interpreted as Issue Remediation entry? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Are success criteria measurable for proving no Issue Remediation successor is created for all six supported non-remediation outcomes? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]

## Side-Effect And Mutation Boundaries

- [ ] CHK004 Are live GitHub mutation exclusions complete across close, comment, label application, assignment, dispatch, and automatic setup behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-020, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Are proposed labels specified as recommendation metadata only with `applied: false` and no label-map or sync side effect? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements explicit that SPEC-009F adds no operator mutation controls or action buttons in the `Triage routing` block? [Coverage, Plan §Constraints, Contract §UI Contract]

## Successor And Workflow Drift Controls

- [ ] CHK007 Are non-remediation successor templates and task creation forbidden for every SPEC-009F lane, including `NEEDS_SPEC` and `NEEDS_SPECIALIST`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK008 Are existing helper workflow templates treated only as recommendation context rather than execution targets? [Clarity, Plan §Gate Risks]
- [ ] CHK009 Are success criteria sufficient to detect accidental creation of remediation, specialist-route, close-issue, needs-spec, or other non-remediation successor tasks? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-010, Quickstart §Guardrails]

## Scope Guard Coverage

- [ ] CHK010 Are claim, runner, sandbox, adapter, poller, and auto-merge surfaces explicitly out of scope or forbidden from drift? [Completeness, Spec §FR-038, Workflow §Strict Scope]
- [ ] CHK011 Are static or diff guard requirements specified for forbidden path/content drift from `origin/main...HEAD`? [Measurability, Spec §FR-038, Plan §Exact Likely Implementation Files]
- [ ] CHK012 Are non-Mission-Control absence gates complete and measurable across feature flag, source template, repository identity, supported disposition, and evidence prerequisites? [Coverage, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK013 Are gate-off and non-Mission-Control states required to write no artifacts, activities, proposed labels, dispatches, or successors? [Consistency, Spec §FR-034, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Fixture And Evidence Hygiene

- [ ] CHK014 Are local/test fixtures required for all six supported outcomes without creating or mutating live GitHub issues? [Completeness, Spec §FR-035, Clarifications §UAT And Regression Boundaries]
- [ ] CHK015 Are disposable fixture cleanup requirements measurable with inserted ids, cleanup scope, and post-cleanup zero counts? [Measurability, Spec §FR-037, §SC-009]
